cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the full effect of A Grave Inheritance. The per-opponent iteration and the conditional 'evict 2 voters belonging to every player who FAILS TO PAY' are not expressible in the Effect union — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G2. `text` therefore describes only what `effects` does.
cards.name: A Grave Inheritance
cards.text: Take 2 resources of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then evict 2 voters from the board.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and effect of Eradicating Germs. DROPPED: the mandatory RECURRING obligation ('Discard an open Voter Card every turn' — a per-turn duty on a player, needs PlayerState.obligations, KNOWN-GAPS G3) and the denomination ('any 1 resource denoted on it', which needs the discarded card's cost surfaced as a Choice, G17). An earlier revision said 'gain 1 resource, discard 1 resource', which is not this card; the single resolution is the market refresh plus the resource.
cards.name: Eradicating Germs
cards.text: Every face-up Voter Card is discarded and replaced with a fresh one. You then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of Singularity ('Get 2 voters'). The second branch ('Collect and use 3 Singularity cards to permanently unlock any Level 5 Ideologue Power', 4 copies in the deck) is a set-collection op that does not exist — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G6.
cards.name: Singularity
cards.text: Gain 2 voters. They are not from a Voter Card, so you may place them in different zones.

cards.source: REF 4.2.1 (scribd 915391788/2040-Deck-CC) recovers the name and the first branch of The Psychohistorian ('Get 1 voter (not card) and any 2 resources'). The second branch is a hidden three-action combo detector ('Trade resources with an opponent. Break one of their majorities. Play another Conspiracy Card on them') which needs a set-combo op and a secrecy flag — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G7.
cards.name: The Psychohistorian
cards.text: Gain 1 voter and 2 resources of your choice. The voter is not from a Voter Card.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.1 (the name puns on the mechanic) and REF 8.2.
cards.name: Confidential Annex
cards.text: Gain 2 Funds and 1 Trust from the Public Reserve. Then get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. The steal-then-voter shape is the same archetype as the recovered A Grave Inheritance (REF 4.2.1) with the conditional clause removed.
cards.name: Quiet Redrafting
cards.text: Take 1 resource of your choice from a chosen opponent. Then gain 1 voter.

cards.name: The Wet Season Argument
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2. refresh-market is the only op in the union with no payload; the market is never allowed below RULES.marketSize, so dealing three is always legal (RULES p10).
cards.name: Filed Under Normal
cards.text: Get 1 discount on a purchase this turn. Then discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones.
